title: 第一卷 第18章 三层测试第一卷 第17章 红衣弟子
slug: 百倍返还我家孽徒全是女帝转世
content_zh:
高台一侧，震炎扫过慵懒闲散的林枫，低声嗤笑一声。
“说起来，我倒是颇为担忧林峰主。”
“如今各大主峰都要争抢良才，其余几峰还算底蕴充足，只有小竹峰荒废许久……”
“只怕到最后没有弟子愿意去往小竹峰，白白辜负林峰主的心愿。”
有几位峰主暗暗对视一眼，跟着假意附和几句，言语之间尽是隐晦的看轻。
林峰并没有搭理他们，但是却已经在内心宣判了他们的死期。
如今他的灵根已经修复了六成，只等这一次任务完成了。
很快，第一道测根骨试炼正式开启。
测灵石立于演武台中央，通体莹白，可以测试修士的根骨资质，优劣一目了然。
一个个年轻人上前测试根骨，然而随着时间流逝，上品根骨者仍然非常少。
就在众人以为本次大典不会出现绝世天才之时，一道明艳张扬的身影，从人群中踏出。
少女一身烈焰红劲装，长发高高束起，眉眼明媚张扬。
她径直走向测灵石，将手按了上去。
下一秒，喧闹的演武场骤然安静下来，接着全场直接沸腾。
只见莹白的测灵石，刹那间被极致的赤红灵光彻底吞噬！
滚烫耀眼的红光冲天而起。
守试长老浑身一震，声音都带上了难以抑制的颤抖。
“竟然是万年难遇的赤炎道体！！”
全场的参选弟子瞠目结舌，就连几个峰主都直起身望了过来。
震炎目光死死锁着下方红衣少女，眼底精光爆闪。

这等优秀的弟子，天生就该入他岩崖峰！
其余峰主也纷纷面露惊喜。
唯独林枫依旧坐姿松散，神色平淡。
玄清真人也是难掩欣喜，声音浩荡威严，传遍全场。
“赤炎道体，千载难逢，准予直通二轮、三轮终极试炼！”
话音落，演武台侧面，一面数十丈高的古朴心境石壁缓缓升起。
此乃青云宗的心性试炼石，内藏万千幻象、世俗贪念，最能考验修士道心定力。
“赤瑶，入心境石门，试炼道心。”守试长老高声传令。
几位峰主目光齐齐聚焦少女身上，满心期待。
赤瑶神色不改，火红身影径直走入光幕之中。
旁人的心性试炼，大多会遭遇亲人离别、功名利禄、身陷绝境等考验。
可现在石壁之内，却显现出一片人间炼狱的景象，漫天烈火焚烧大地，四周是无尽厮杀血战。
若是心性稍弱，要么被恐惧击溃，要么被凶性吞噬。
台下众人屏息凝神，不少弟子看得头皮发麻。
可幻境之中，赤瑶身姿挺拔如松，双目澄澈锐利，不见丝毫慌乱怯懦。
她本就性子热烈坦荡，天生刚直，不惧生死。
漫天火海焚身，她便立身其中，任由烈火冲刷身躯。
“道在我心，何惧虚妄！”
一声清亮叱喝响彻幻境，她周身赤光暴涨，一身炙热道心硬生生震碎了幻象！
短短数息时间，漫天火海尽数消散，赤瑶踏步走出，神色淡然。

守试长老再度失声惊叹：“无惑无妄，赤心守道！心性测试通过！”
全场又是一阵轰然骚动！
content_en:
On the side of the high platform, Zhen Yan swept over the lazy Lin Feng and sneered in a low voice.
"Speaking of which, I am quite worried about Peak Master Lin."
"Nowadays, all the major peaks are competing for talented people. The other peaks have sufficient foundation. Only Xiaozhu Peak has been abandoned for a long time..."
"I'm afraid that in the end, no disciple will be willing to go to Xiaozhu Peak, and I will live up to Master Lin's wish."
Several peak masters looked at each other secretly, and then added a few false words, their words filled with implicit contempt.
Lin Feng didn't pay attention to them, but he had already pronounced their death sentence in his heart.
Now that his spiritual root has been repaired by 60%, he is just waiting for this mission to be completed.
Soon, the first bone-testing trial officially began.
The spirit-testing stone stands in the center of the martial arts stage. It is completely white and can test the monk's aptitude. The good and bad can be seen at a glance.
Young people stepped forward to test the root bones one after another. However, as time passed, there were still very few people with high-grade root bones.
Just when everyone thought that there would be no peerless genius in this ceremony, a bright and flamboyant figure stepped out from the crowd.
The girl was dressed in a fiery red outfit, with her long hair tied high and her eyebrows bright and flamboyant.
She walked straight to the spirit-testing stone and pressed her hand on it.
The next second, the noisy martial arts arena suddenly became quiet, and then the whole place was boiling.
I saw the white spiritual stone being completely swallowed up by the extreme red spiritual light in an instant!
Hot and dazzling red light rose into the sky.
Elder Shoushi was shaken all over, and his voice had an uncontrollable tremor.
"It turned out to be a red flame Taoist body that is rare to see in ten thousand years!!"
All the participating disciples were dumbfounded, and even several peak masters stood up and looked over.
Zhen Yan's eyes were locked on the girl in red below, his eyes sparkling.
Such outstanding disciples were born to join his Yanya Peak!
The other peak masters also expressed surprise.
Only Lin Feng still sat loosely and looked dull.
Master Xuanqing could not hide his joy, and his voice was loud and majestic, spreading throughout the entire audience.
"The Red Flame Dao Body, once in a lifetime, is allowed to pass through the second and third rounds of the ultimate trial!"
After the words fell, on the side of the martial arts stage, a simple stone wall with a height of dozens of feet slowly rose up.
This is the test stone of Qingyun Sect's mind. It contains thousands of illusions and worldly greed, and can best test the monk's concentration.
"Chiyao, enter the Shimen of the Heart Realm and test the Taoist Heart." The elder guarding the trial shouted the order.
Several peak masters focused their eyes on the girl, full of expectations.
Chi Yao's expression did not change, and the fiery red figure walked straight into the light curtain.
Most of the trials of others' xinxing include separation from relatives, fame and fortune, and being in desperate situations.
But now inside the stone wall, there is a scene of purgatory on earth, with fire burning across the sky and the earth surrounded by endless bloody battles.
If the mind is weak, it will either be defeated by fear or swallowed up by viciousness.
Everyone in the audience held their breath and concentrated, and many disciples felt their scalps numb.
But in the illusion, Chi Yao's figure is as tall and straight as a pine, his eyes are clear and sharp, and there is no trace of panic or cowardice.
She has a warm and open temperament, is naturally upright, and is not afraid of life or death.
She stood in the sea of ​​flames and let the fire wash over her body.
"The Tao is in my heart, why should I be afraid of falsehood!"
A clear shout resounded through the illusion, the red light around her body surged, and her hot Taoist heart suddenly shattered the illusion!
In just a few breaths, all the sea of ​​fire dissipated, and Chi Yao stepped out with a calm expression.
The elder Shoushi once again exclaimed: "No confusion, no delusion, and abiding by the Tao with all my heart! Passed the character test!"
There was another loud commotion in the whole place!
